en.headline: Monster Mash Fest brings family Halloween activities to Central today
en.dek: Hongkong Land’s Halloween in Central event holds a free family day on Chater Road with costumes, face painting and a themed bouncy castle.
body: Hongkong Land’s Halloween in Central programme continues on Saturday with Monster Mash Fest, a family-focused day on the pedestrianised section of Chater Road.

The event runs from noon to 9pm and is free to enter. Visitors can dress in costumes or use on-site booths for outfits and accessories. Face painting and henna art with Halloween and local motifs are available, along with live performances and festive food stalls.

A large themed bouncy castle is open for timed sessions that require a separate fee and on-site sign-up. Immersive installations at Statue Square Gardens (South), including a giant eyeball display, remain lit from 4pm to 11.30pm.

The broader Halloween in Central runs until 31 October, organised by Hongkong Land with support from the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Other districts also hold cosplay street parties on selected Saturdays as part of the city’s Halloween Month.

zh.headline: 中環大小怪獸嘉年華今日舉行親子萬聖節活動
zh.dek: 置地公司「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」於遮打道舉辦免費親子日，設服裝攤位、臉部彩繪及主題彈跳城堡。
body: 置地公司主辦的「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」周六舉行「大小怪獸嘉年華」，在遮打道行人專用區舉辦親子活動。
活動由中午12時至晚上9時，免費入場。市民可盛裝出席，或在現場服裝配飾攤位打扮。現場有融合萬聖節與本地元素的臉部彩繪及Henna手繪，並有現場表演及節日小食。
大型主題彈跳城堡開放時段入場，需另行收費並於現場登記。皇后像廣場花園（南）的沉浸式裝置，包括巨型眼球，每晚下午4時至晚上11時30分亮燈。
「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」由置地公司主辦、香港旅遊發展局支持，活動持續至10月31日。其他地區亦於指定星期六舉行Cosplay街頭派對，作為全城萬聖節月的一部分。
